title: Another calcium signal
hook: Connect a hormonal signal with a target.

knows: Hormones can carry signals through the blood to target tissues.
doesNotKnow: Calcitonin can inhibit bone resorption and lower blood calcium; its physiological role in adult humans is less prominent than that of parathyroid hormone.

misconception: All hormones come from one gland and act on every cell.
objective: Identify the stated endocrine signal and its target in a simplified pathway.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Which hormone released by thyroid C cells can lower blood calcium by inhibiting bone resorption? Calcitonin can inhibit bone resorption and lower blood calcium; its physiological role in adult humans is less prominent than that of parathyroid hormone.
The diagram shows one selected source–target pathway, not all hormone effects or feedback loops.

Recall: In the stated example, which source releases Calcitonin into the circulation? Calcitonin can inhibit bone resorption and lower blood calcium; its physiological role in adult humans is less prominent than that of parathyroid hormone.
